title: Normalized scalar-extension data and trace of the completed unit
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an inclusion $\iota:E\to F$. Define unit and unitComplex as the completed regular coefficient module in degree zero, and twistedUnit as its exact Tate twist followed by $[2d]$. Over a finite-field datum with $\ell\ne p$, residueInverse transports the inverse of $\ell$ along residue-field maps and overTwistedUnit uses that specified inverse. UnitMultiplication consists of a chain isomorphism from ordinary scalar extension of unitComplex to the new unit complex, its sectionwise formula $b\otimes x\mapsto b\iota(x)$, a derived unit isomorphism, and the equation identifying its derived map with the universal K-flat counit followed by that chain map. For a compactification $c$ of $f:X\to Y$ and $d\in\mathbf N$, CoefficientComparison consists of these unit multiplications at $X,Y$ and an invertible compact-support comparison pinned to the actual published coefficient adjunction mate. Define twistComparison from the canonical scalar/shift comparison, the ordinary Tate-twist comparison, and unit multiplication. Define trace from a given base trace $t_0$ as $P_F(\theta^{-1})$ followed by the inverse compact-support comparison, derived scalar extension of $t_0$ and target unit multiplication. Also retain baseInclusion from the universe lift of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. No scalar trace coherence theorem is asserted.
